core_obligations: Boundedness: the base change lands in the bounded coherent derived category by construction (proof line 4294)

Finiteness of injective dimension: the ideals of the target between the extended ideal and the ring correspond to ideals of the source, so the criterion for finite injective dimension applies (proof lines 4295-4308)
The duality axiom: the base change statement for internal homs turns the double dual of the base change into the ring itself (proof lines 4309-4313)
proof_roadmap: 由跨章引理 RHom_B(K ⊗_A B, ω_A^• ⊗_A B) = RHom_A(K, ω_A^•) ⊗_A B；又 IB ⊂ J ⊂ B 与 I ⊂ J' ⊂ A 一一对应 ⇒ 由有限内射维数判据得 ω_A^• ⊗_A B 有限内射维数。
再由同一引理：RHom_B(ω_A^• ⊗_A B, ω_A^• ⊗_A B) = RHom_A(ω_A^•, ω_A^•) ⊗_A B = B。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that under the stated flatness and fibre conditions the base change of a dualizing complex is a dualizing complex (author lemma at source lines 4284-4292, label lemma-flat-iso-mod-I). The proof (source lines 4294-4314) verifies the three axioms: boundedness is immediate, finite injective dimension comes from the ideal correspondence and the Noetherian criterion, and the duality axiom from the base change statement for internal homs (proof lines 4294-4313). The ideal correspondence is the substance. H3.
